name: Etsuko Mobile v1.3.2 — Permanent Signing Keystore & In-Place Update Compatibility
body:
### ⚡ What's New in v1.3.2:
- **Permanent Keystore Signature:** Integrated persistent release keystore so all future in-app updates install seamlessly over existing installations with zero package/signature conflicts.
- **Unified Queue & Recommended For You:** Recommended For You is the sole source of Smart Autoplay — zero title-matching search results in the queue.
- **Sequential Pool Consumption:** Songs are consumed directly from the recommendation pool without repeating played tracks.
- **Instant Search Latency:** Removed artificial delays and added instant LRU query caching with 160ms responsive debounce.
- **Verified Offline Playback:** Full audio playback, seeking, scrubbing, and duration with zero dummy silence.
